question.text: If <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>250</mn><msup><mi>cm</mi><mn>3</mn></msup></math>of an aqueous solution containing <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>0</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>73</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">g</mi></math> of a protein <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">A</mi></math> is isotonic with one litre of another aqueous solution containing <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>1</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>65</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">g</mi></math> of a protein <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">B</mi><mo>,</mo></math> at <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>298</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">K</mi></math>, the ratio of the molecular masses of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">A</mi></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">B</mi></math> is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>_</mo><mo>_</mo><mo>_</mo><mo>_</mo><mo>_</mo><mo>_</mo><mo>_</mo><mo>_</mo><mo>_</mo><mo>_</mo><mo>_</mo><mo>×</mo><msup><mn>10</mn><mrow><mo>−</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup></math> (to the nearest integer).
